title: Mainbread's Artifacts
description: This Mod adds 2 new custom armor sets and various new items and recipes.
body:
![The Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9f05dad9952d8092a2985e77e5cd451a15669f9.png) What is Mainbread's Artifacts? --- Mainbread's Artifacts is a mod that introduces new content and features to Minecraft, providing more opportunities for exploration, discovery. Where can you find the ores? --- **Ruby Ore** The Ruby Ore can be found just above the Deepslate layer in the Overworld. **Aquanite Ore** Aquanite Ore can be found rarely in the End. Recipes ---
Spoiler ![The recipe for the smithing hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4dbb8c76b17c348cb7782ba505e398a18db1195e_0.webp)

Details --- This mod is compatible with almost every other mod. It will not be available on other Mod launchers. Requirements --- This mod requires Fabric API!

``` This is my first mod, and I hope you enjoy it!☀️ ```
